```lean
intro h
split
· intro s a ha
  have : ∀ x ∈ s, x < a → f x < f (insert a s) :=
    by rintro x ⟨hx, hx⟩; exact h _ _ hx ha
  rw [insert_eq] at this
  apply this
· intro h'
  intros s t hst
  refine StrictMono.domRestrict _ h'
  intro x y hxy
  rcases lt_iff_le_and_lt.1 hxy with (hle : x ≤ y) (hlt : x < y)
  cases le_total x y with hxy' hxy''
  · exact hle
  · rcases hst with ⟨s, hss, hs⟩
    obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hss
    have : ∀ x ∈ s, x < a → f x < f (insert a s) :=
      by rintro x ⟨hx, hx⟩; exact h' _ _ hx ha
    rw [insert_eq] at this
    apply this
```
